description: Defines the CalendarSyncOperation class representing a calendar synchronization operation, including its properties, constructor, and getter methods.

classes.name: CalendarSyncOperation
classes.description: Represents an operation to synchronize calendar data with properties for user ID, calendar account ID, subject ID, location, action, and an optional payload.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of CalendarSyncOperation with specified properties.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with the sync operation.

methods.name: getSubjectId
methods.description: Returns the subject ID of the calendar item.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the location type of the calendar item.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Returns the action to perform in the sync process.
